decRows.kpi: Three-phase load balance (phase current imbalance)
decRows.bench: Phase current imbalance not more than 10% (auditor benchmark, to be confirmed)
decRows.ref: Decathlon EFSA KPI; NBC 2016 Part 8 Sec 2; IS 732:2019
decRows.guide: Benchmark used in the Decathlon reports: Currents per phase compared; 'well balanced'.

decRows.kpi: Phase–neutral supply voltage within permissible range
decRows.bench: 230 V +/-6% (216.2 to 243.8 V), as used in the Decathlon reports (to be confirmed)
decRows.ref: Decathlon EFSA KPI; CEA Safety & Electric Supply Regulations; NBC Part 8 Sec 2
decRows.guide: Benchmark used in the Decathlon reports: 230 V ±6% (implied).

decRows.kpi: Power factor at main incomer
decRows.bench: Not less than 0.95; 0.90 to 0.95 partially compliant (energy KPI, to be confirmed)
decRows.ref: Decathlon EFSA KPI; Supply utility tariff conditions / BEE practice
decRows.guide: Benchmark used in the Decathlon reports: ~0.96–0.97 'satisfactory'.

decRows.kpi: Current harmonic distortion (THD-i)
decRows.bench: Not more than 15% (Decathlon report benchmark, to be confirmed; IEEE 519 TDD limit depends on Isc/IL)
decRows.ref: Decathlon EFSA KPI; IEEE 519 (TDD limit depends on Isc/IL ratio)
decRows.guide: Benchmark used in the Decathlon reports: ≤15% (report benchmark).

decRows.kpi: Voltage harmonic distortion (THD-v)
decRows.bench: Not more than 8% (IEEE 519, up to 1 kV)
decRows.ref: Decathlon EFSA KPI; IEEE 519 (8% for ≤1 kV)
decRows.guide: Benchmark used in the Decathlon reports: ≤8%.

decRows.kpi: Neutral-to-earth voltage at main panel, cable alley, UPS incomer/outgoing
decRows.bench: Less than 1.0 V (Decathlon report benchmark, to be confirmed)
decRows.ref: Decathlon EFSA KPI; IS 3043:2018 (good practice); OEM/IT equipment norms
decRows.guide: Benchmark used in the Decathlon reports: <1.0 V (report benchmark).

decRows.kpi: Earth pit resistance (each pit, measured)
decRows.bench: LV equipment earth not more than 2 ohm; above 2 up to 5 ohm partially compliant; above 5 ohm non-compliant (Ver3 auditor benchmark, IS 3043 practice)
decRows.ref: Decathlon EFSA KPI; IS 3043:2018; CEA Safety Regulations
decRows.guide: Benchmark used in the Decathlon reports: Ω values; 'OK'. Related library requirement(s): G-07, P-40.

decRows.kpi: Dedicated / segregated earth pit for UPS & IT loads, identified
decRows.ref: Decathlon EFSA KPI; IS 3043:2018
decRows.guide: Benchmark used in the Decathlon reports: Separate pit expected.

decRows.kpi: Earth pit marking: pit no., last test date, next due date, measured value displayed at pit
decRows.ref: Decathlon EFSA KPI; IS 3043:2018; CEA Safety Regulations (periodic earth testing)
decRows.guide: Benchmark used in the Decathlon reports: Display at pit.

decRows.kpi: Earth strip / conductor condition (corrosion)
decRows.ref: Decathlon EFSA KPI; IS 3043:2018
decRows.guide: Benchmark used in the Decathlon reports: No rust.

decRows.kpi: Earth continuity of every 3-pin socket outlet (tested)
decRows.ref: Decathlon EFSA KPI; IS 3043:2018; IS 732:2019
decRows.guide: Benchmark used in the Decathlon reports: Continuity tester – 'properly connected'. Related library requirement(s): O-04, P-37.

decRows.kpi: Cable gland earthing (metal glands bonded)
decRows.ref: Decathlon EFSA KPI; IS 732:2019 / IS 12943 (as cited in report)
decRows.guide: Benchmark used in the Decathlon reports: Earthed with copper wire.

decRows.kpi: Cable glands provided at all cable entries into DBs / MCB boxes
decRows.ref: Decathlon EFSA KPI; IS 732:2019
decRows.guide: Benchmark used in the Decathlon reports: Glands present.

decRows.kpi: Thermographic scan of panels, breakers, contactors, busbars, cable terminations – hotspot temperature
decRows.bench: Record hotspot temperature and the difference from similar components; acceptance limit to be agreed with the client
decRows.ref: Decathlon EFSA KPI; No IS; NETA MTS ΔT criteria commonly used
decRows.guide: Benchmark used in the Decathlon reports: Hotspot °C; 'marginally higher' ~50–64 °C.

decRows.kpi: Electrical panel room ventilation / cooling and room temperature
decRows.bench: Record room temperature; acceptance limit to be agreed with the client
decRows.ref: Decathlon EFSA KPI; NBC 2016 Part 8 Sec 2
decRows.guide: Benchmark used in the Decathlon reports: Room temp (SL 27 °C) and ventilation. Related library requirement(s): G-13.

decRows.kpi: Illumination level in electrical / UPS / panel rooms
decRows.bench: Not less than 450 lux (Decathlon report benchmark, to be confirmed; IS 3646 range 350 to 500 lux)
decRows.ref: Decathlon EFSA KPI; IS 3646 (Part 1):1992; NBC 2016 Part 8 Sec 1
decRows.guide: Benchmark used in the Decathlon reports: ≥450 lux (report); 350–500 lux in gap table. Related library requirement(s): E-03.

decRows.kpi: Cable / conductor identification tagging
decRows.ref: Decathlon EFSA KPI; IS 5578 & IS 11353 (as cited)
decRows.guide: Benchmark used in the Decathlon reports: All cables tagged.

decRows.kpi: MCB / circuit labelling in DBs and blanking plates on unused ways; equipment labelling
decRows.ref: Decathlon EFSA KPI; IS 8623 (as cited); IS 732:2019
decRows.guide: Benchmark used in the Decathlon reports: Labels + blanking plates. Related library requirement(s): G-08.

decRows.kpi: Panels clean and free from dust and moisture
decRows.ref: Decathlon EFSA KPI; IS 732:2019
decRows.guide: Benchmark used in the Decathlon reports: Visual.

decRows.kpi: Phase-to-phase (line) supply voltage within tolerance
decRows.bench: 415 V +/-10% (373.5 to 456.5 V), as used in the Decathlon reports (to be confirmed)
decRows.ref: Decathlon EFSA KPI; CEA (Measures relating to Safety & Electric Supply) Regs; supply code
decRows.guide: Benchmark used in the Decathlon reports: 415 V ±10% (implied).

decRows.kpi: Neutral current at main incomer
decRows.bench: Record neutral current; investigate if it exceeds the lowest phase current
decRows.ref: Decathlon EFSA KPI; IS 732:2019
decRows.guide: Benchmark used in the Decathlon reports: Not stated.

decRows.kpi: Socket outlet polarity (phase–neutral reversal) and neutral continuity
decRows.ref: Decathlon EFSA KPI; IS 732:2019
decRows.guide: Benchmark used in the Decathlon reports: Socket tester.

decRows.kpi: Earth electrode type and earth conductor size (pipe/plate electrode, main earth strip/bus, not just cable)

sev.name: Negligible
sev.desc: Administrative or documentation gap with no direct effect on fire development, detection, escape or firefighting.

sev.name: Minor
sev.desc: Local deficiency; slight delay or inconvenience to escape or firefighting; no injury expected.

sev.name: Moderate
sev.desc: Reduces the reliability of one fire safety measure, or affects a limited area or number of people; injury possible.

sev.name: Major
sev.desc: Loss or serious impairment of a fire safety measure (for example a compartment line, an alarm zone, one of two exits); serious injury possible, major property loss.

sev.name: Catastrophic
sev.desc: Failure of a primary life safety measure for many occupants (for example blocked or locked exits, no alarm, no fire water, pumps not available); multiple fatalities possible.

lik.name: Rare
lik.desc: Isolated, short-lived lapse; strong compensating measures; low fire load and few people exposed.

lik.name: Unlikely
lik.desc: Isolated deficiency; other layers of protection are in place and working.

lik.name: Possible
lik.desc: Deficiency at several locations or recurring; partial compensating measures.

lik.name: Likely
lik.desc: Widespread or long-standing deficiency; ignition sources or high occupancy present; weak compensating measures.

lik.name: Almost certain
lik.desc: Deficiency throughout the building or permanent by design; no compensating measures; the measure would not work if called upon today.

grades.name: Low
grades.action: Rectify through routine maintenance; verify at next audit.

grades.name: Medium
grades.action: Plan and complete corrective action; management to track closure.

grades.name: High
grades.action: Priority corrective action; interim risk controls until closed; senior management review.

grades.name: Critical
grades.action: Immediate action. Apply interim measures at once (fire watch, restrict occupancy or use, restore the system); inform the owner in writing on the day of the audit.
